name: TreasureTails
storyline:
A curious journey where you play as a cute cat named Mikado. Follow your instincts and solve clues to find and unearth hidden bounties, riches and ancient artifacts. Sell, gift or collect them as you please. Learn more about the world around you and its many mysteries!

Explore a land full of wonders and hidden treasures with the help of your trusted shovel and metal detector. Every beep is potentially a great find!

Drive around in a pickup truck or take your time and walk to wherever your curiosity takes you, there's no rush.

Chat with other villagers and treasure hunters, they might just give you clues or hints on where to find treasures.

Follow the main trails or go off-road in search of forgotten long-lost treasures, the world is your oyster!

Sell your findings to other villagers or add them to your collection.
summary: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.
